6606356.beer_description: Troubled in its youth, Pilsner has returned to its roots, hops. A modern expression, with the classic. peppy finish. All the NZ heros are there, Motueka, Riwaka, Peacherine, Waimea and Manilita. Late kettle, WP and a DDH with some extra Peacharine HopKief for the finishing zhuzh. Fruit forward, with classic tropical, grapefruit, stonefruit and guava characters. The dry body brings drinkability, with a white pepper finish, leaving you wanting another.

6606352.beer_description:
We’re rolling up at the lights next to our mates from @hikerbrewing, and by "rolling up" we mean nervously stalling it twice in a clapped-out four-banger.

This cracking West Coast DIPA is full beans straight out the tap, hops flat to the floor, heel-toeing between bitterness and malt sweetness in a pair of Dan's not-so-metaphorical thongs.

It’s full throttle ballet in a glass - Simcoe, Mosaic and Motueka bouncing off the rim like a tacho kissing the limiter, with a clutch dump full of pine, resin, lime citrus and finishing with a tropical skid on your tastebuds. It'll hit harder than a mis-shift into second and get your palate rattling like the gearbox in our delivery van.

6511064.beer_description:
Quadrupling down to get the most thiol loaded hazy we can manage, we’ve partnered with the boffins at Freestyle Hops to go full beer geek. Kicking off with Undermodified Pilsner malt from Voyager. With less modification comes more bound thiols, the precursors to thiol flavour. Next comes Sauvignon Blanc juice. Rich in 3MH (grapefruit), 3MHA (passionfruit) and 4MMP (gooseberry). Up comes Nelson Sauvin and Mega Motueka in the mash. At this temperature the mash proteases unlock the 4MMP and 3S4MP from the Nelson and Mega Motueka, which is a red wine musk infused version of Motueka. Extremely rich in thiols. The Manilita and Waimea add rich NZ hop aromatics. Fermentation sees a strong dry hop hit at high krausen, where the yeast activity brings biotransformation with alacrity. Here, more Mega Mot, Nelson and Manilita shine, releasing thiols in abundance. A cold dry hop adds to the overall intensity and brings those unique NZ aromatic to the fore. 

It’s a big old complex juice bomb. Unmistakably kiwi with an overload of passionfruit, blackcurrant, grapefruit, gooseberry and diesel. Super charged aromatics over a soft and pillowy body. Land of the long white cloud indeed, it’s soft and gentle, with the hop flavours on show. A joy to develop something that really pushes a hop element as far as it can go, with our mates at Freestyle.

6568562.beer_description:
Inspired by the classics cocktail, this lime juice kettle sour was infused with juniper berries and orange zest. The lactose adds balance to the citric sourness, with fresh lime juice dominating. Juniper berries were macerated in neutral spirit for 7 days, before being infused with some orange zest and dosed into the final product.

Lime and botanicals on the nose, with a lime cordial and red berry mid palate and salty sour finish. All the flavours in balance, leading to a refreshing experience tailored to these long summer arvos.

6568563.beer_description:
It’s the breakfast cereal beer you never knew you wanted. Lemon, lime and orange over a corn syrup body and citrus sour finish. A generous, fun filled pack of breakfast sour beer.

All the citrus comes first. Candied versions of lemon, lime and orange giving Saturday morning cartoons, with pjs all day. Some corn like viscous body brings the cereal character, with more generic citrus flavours through the middle. The finish is both sour and sweet, to deliver drinkability. Nostalgic yet novel.

6555433.beer_description:
This one lives past the redline. Built on instinct and pushed without restraint, we locked in maximum juice and tuned it for a bright, dangerously drinkable ride. Mosaic lays down the power, while Peacharine and Waimea hit the NOS and send it screaming. Familiar names, zero complacency - a calculated gamble at full throttle, where the risk is real and the reward is everything.

Tropical, stone and citrus fruits crash at high speed in a juiced up flavour bomb. Peacharine and Waimea delivers classic stone fruit, with hints of guava and diesel. Mosaic delivers that familiar citric-tropical party. The rolled oats and wheat keep the body full but drinkable.

6301316.beer_description:
Even the most fastidious plan comes unravelled when Working Title gets involved. A super smooth and silky RIS, aimed at Makers Mark Bourbon Barrels for a short sojourn, left for 12 months because we laugh in the face of scheduling. The result is unexpected but superior, like it was always meant to be.

12 malts drive the chocolate complexity; with savoury biscuit, sweet caramel and bitter chocolate all contributing their opinion. Gentle notes of rye, oats and wheat add to the cacophony. A perfect RIS combo of Willamette, Simcoe and Columbus barely waylay the chaos of dank pine, minty spice and a balanced white pepper bitterness. An ambitious project that confused itself in its simplicity.

6517143.beer_description:
Because the journey is more important than its destination, each year we finish with a beer that champions our discovery of hop things in the inevitable Pursuit of Happiness. Four things we learned in 2025; Mash hopping drives biotransformation, Simcoe is the perfect Red IPA hop, more hops at more times is more and Riwaka Amplifier from Clayton Hops is a powerful ally.

2025 saw us return to our favourite IPA style: Red. Mucking about with terpenes, thiols and esters is all well and good, but the confluence of rich malts with rich hops is what floats our boats. This year we focused on hopping all over the gaff, from mash in to first wort, coolpools, day 0, high krausen, chill back and cold DH. The results were clear: adding more hops at more times points gives richer hop experience. Intuitive, for sure, but you never never know if you never never jam them in everywhere. Some hoppings didn’t work for the Reds, in our opinion. Day 0, late ferment and too much in high krausen were all either just not impactful or too astringent. Overall, the strategy for hopping Red IPAs is congruent with the malt bill, just add more!

6568567.beer_description:
2013; craft beer had arrived and Brisbane was ready. Real beer, made with proper ingredients, no corners cut and focused on flavour. It was a bold move to land on an aggressively hopped, crystal and biscuit malt loaded American IPA but the reception was positive. Quickly it become the flagship, a totem of the movement, fresh IPA.

Many years and many iterations later, we've gone back to the original recipe. Cascade, Citra, Simcoe and Centennial. With a Carahell and Biscuit malt backbone, the structure is supportive of big hop additions. Bitterness is high, but may not be perceived from the viscous body. Pine, resin, and grapefruit mostly, with some subtle pineapple and stone fruit hits along the way. Big, bold and uncompromising, a journey that's come full circle.

6384044.beer_name: Where the Wild Things Are - Girraween (2025)
6384044.beer_description:
Last time we looked at Dan’s wild captured yeast in a 12 month barrel ferment. This time, we’ve gone fully stainless ferment, to allow the subtle yeast characters to really be the hero. A two week primary ferment in this context, allows the yeast to shine without influences from the oak or aging process.

This insanely unique yeast profile really presents like an Australian Saison, with predominant esters of peach, pear and red apple, layered with some stone fruits, and with some very soft peppery phenolics for balance. It drinks full, even though it’s incredibly dry. Familiar but distinct, what a great expression of Australian Wild Beer.

6368606.beer_name: Where the Wild Things Are - Maleny (2025)
6368606.beer_description:
A spontaneously harvested, native mixed culture 3 years in the making. Hot wort made in Doggett St was raced up to the family farm and laid down in mini koelships in various different plots, directly exposed to the elements. Allowed to cool over night, samples were collected the next morning and fermented for a few weeks in demijohns. Selecting samples that saw a good fermentation profile and had attractive aromatic attributes, they were scaled up into carbouys. A further round of culling saw a final scale for the best sample up to neutral oak. A 12 month, slow ferment allowed the full expression of the mixed culture. From this 300L batch, a further 12 month scale up was made to 5 x 300L barrels, allowing us to pack this QLD first, and get it into your hands.

Subtle, bread-like, stone fruit and floral esters on the nose, provide a complex array of unique aromatics. Brett and sour bacteria like character is also evident. A tart, zippy finish leaves the overall impression full but refreshing. A dominant sour exotic stone fruit character pervades the experience. Maleny never tasted so funky.

6384049.beer_description:
A six month barrel fermented Flanders inspired Golden Sour was blended with young Belgian Blond, and refermented on fresh peach juice. Seeking that balance of a true Flanders, where fruit driven sweetness combines with puckering acetic driven acidity.

Delicate peach aromatics combine with a Brettanomyces bruxellensis funk and Acetobacter sourness. A gentle honey treacle mid palate softness the complex sourness, providing a balanced drinkability.

6571294.beer_description: Dark meets light in this dark lager. A smooth and sessionable dark lager with notes of roasted nuts, bread crusts and caramel. With a light body, it comes without the heaviness that usually comes with darker beer styles. This is the perfect warm-weather thirst quencher. Light body, full taste. Keg only.

5912822.beer_description: Easy drinking and refreshing Aussie Summer Ale. Brewed in a dedicated Gluten Free Brewery.

3128526.beer_description:
Our IPA is bursting with flavour and bite, giving off pine and fruity aromatics. A beautifully-hopped IPA brewed with millet and buckwheat; showcasing Galaxy and Mosaic hops. Gold medal winner at both the INDIES and AIBAs. It's also endorsed by Coeliac Australia!

YEAST: US05
MALTS: Pale Millet Malt, Vienna Millet Malt, Goldfinch Millet Malt, Cara Millet Malt
HOPS: Galaxy, Mosaic, Amarillo, Magnum

5727516.beer_description:
Toriaezu, biiru! (First and foremost, a beer!). Rice has been a staple ingredient in Japanese brewing for millennia, giving beers a lighter colour, taste and body, making them refreshing with low bitterness. Lightly hopped, this ultra dry, super crisp lager is an easy drinker that will keep you coming back for another glass. Kanpai!

Full size serve, full strength, but without the carbs.

Japanese Rice Lager is lower in carbohydrate and lower in bitterness. This easy drinking, full strength beer is a perfect thirst quencher for the carb conscious beer lover. 

YEAST: 34/70
MALTS: Malted Millet, Malted Rice, Raw Rice
HOPS: Saphir, Mosaic, Incognito

4307357.beer_description: A clean, fruitful lager, showcasing Vienna Millet Malt, brewed as an easy-drinking, light pale straw-coloured version of a German Pilsner. TWØBAYS fourth core beer features tangerine and citrus aromas, with a smooth, crisp palate, hints of delicate grains and a sharp refreshing finish.

6169060.beer_description: Corn chips and dips have a best friend, and it’s called Cerveza! And just like corn chips, there’s a good dose of corn in this brew too. This Mexican style lager is cool, crisp and easy drinking - if it were in a bottle, you’d have a wedge of lime in it for sure.

6189857.beer_description:
The World's Best GF Beer - World Beer Cup Gold 2025

New to the core range, Pacific Ale has dethroned our very own Session Ale as the World's best GF beer at the World Beer Cup 2025. It is packed with Australian and NZ hops. Low bitterness with a big, fruity hop profile makes this an easy drinking and sessionable beer. Expect hoppy notes of pine, pineapple and citrus.

If you are looking for a flavourful beer experience at a sessionable ABV and without the gluten, this might be the perfect beer for you. All TWØBAYS core range beers are endorsed by Coeliac Australia.

YEAST: US05
MALTS: Vienna Millet, Yellow Corn, Cara Millet
HOPS: Galaxy, Nelson Sauvin

2978227.beer_description: Easy drinking American hopped ale with fruity palate and citrus aromas

6497756.beer_description: Raspberry Berliner Weisse features a powerful raspberry aroma, backed up by refreshing tart and juicy flavours and a dry finish. Brewed at a lower 3.5% abv, this is the perfect warm-weather thirst quencher

4756090.beer_description: A Mosaic-hopped IPA with a hazy finish, featuring tropical fruit flavours and a crisp, lean palate.

6291287.beer_description: Malty warmth meets a hoppy edge. Think toffee, plum, citrus and a hint of mischief. Balanced but unpredictable, like a friendly card game that's gone suspiciously quiet... except for the thump of a wagging tail.

5885202.beer_description: The next instalment of our favourite adjunct laden stout. This year's rendition has been fermented cold with our house lager yeast and has been conditioned on mountains on toasted hazelnut and coconut. Dolce Noir exudes richness, it's time to stop living down there and start living up here.

3753372.beer_description:
It’s a White Bay kinda day, perfect for a delicious, award-winning
Munich Lager. This Bavarian bewdy might be made with the finest
traditional German hops, but it’s brewed on Sydney Harbour, at
home anywhere.

6357986.beer_description: Confident. Clean cut. Sharp angles and long shadows, walks the line between cold and bitter - leaving a last impression as the credits roll. Owning every scene even when standing still.

6438478.beer_description: In a collaborative effort of White Bay brewers past and present, ‘Steelworked’ pays homage to the time that we called the Rozelle Steelworks home. Hopped with Calypso, Krush, and Mosaic.

6588865.beer_description:
Behold, the power of three! A trio of hops from Australia, NZ, and the USA form a tri-faceted pyramid of deliciousness, featuring Australian Melba, Riwaka from New Zealand, and American Mosaic and Krush hops for a trifecta of vibrance, juiciness, and
massive flavour.

6352125.beer_description:
Rich and smooth, this barrel-aged stout rests in ex-rum casks from our neighbours at Red Mill Rum. Notes of cinnamon and vanilla weave through layers of dark malt, toffee, biscuit, and light chocolate, finishing with a gentle warmth and lingering depth.

Contains Gluten and Lactose.

4147760.beer_description: West Coast IPA is a tip of the hat to a style we hold deep regard and appreciation for but don't brew nearly enough of. Spurred on by Sam the brewer’s thirst for an IPA with some bitterness to it we absolutely pulverised this beer with our whole arsenal of hops, cryo hops and incognito. Dankness lurks in the shadows of piney and berrylicious flavours and aromas. 2010, what a time to be alive!

5405641.beer_description: Enjoy our brand new Banoffee Pie-PA. A thick velvety IPA with notes of toffee, cream and hints of banana. If you have a sweet tooth this is the treat for you.

768311.beer_description: Our Belgian-style IPA, brewed with Saison yeast to give the beer a pepper-like clove aroma. Smooth, malty & mild this is the IPA for IPA lovers and non-lovers alike.

4376766.beer_description: A Black Forest what? Gateau of where? Have your cake and drink it too. Our Black Forest Gateau is loaded with rich chocolate malts, cherries, vanilla and lactose. It's liquid cake! Keep it cold. Drink it fresh!

2799980.beer_description: Dad & Dave’s Citra & Mosaic IPA is double dry hopped, delivering a well-balanced malty-sweet, tropical aroma and guava flavour. Deceptively smooth to drink.

5903878.beer_description:
Crusher Hard Cherry Cola, the blast from the past with a cherry twist!

Unleash the power of cherry and cola and let the crusher take over.

It's not just a drink, it's a lifestyle. Drink responsibly or not at all.

5903877.beer_description:
Crusher Hard Ginger Beer is a bold choice for those who dare.

It's robust ginger flavour delivers a fiery blend of sweetness and spice, perfect for quenching a mighty thirst.

It's a beverage that's as fearless as y0u are.

1280946.beer_description: This pilsner has a fantastic crisp malt body, and an herbaceous lingering yet light bitterness, making it the perfect session beer for those warm afternoons.

6699565.beer_description:
Pouring a vibrant pink, this refreshing sour showcases the bright tropical character of dragonfruit. Subtle sweetness and juicy fruit notes are balanced by a lively acidity that keeps the beer crisp and refreshing.
Light-bodied and vibrant, it’s a colourful, fruit-forward sour with a clean, tangy finish.

3695003.beer_description: Limited release. This dragon fruit sour has a deep pink-red pour with a creamy slightly pink head. Expect mild tartness with flavours of dragonfruit and something similar to berry aroma.

6699563.beer_description:
Pouring a vibrant pink, this refreshing sour showcases the bright tropical character of dragonfruit. Subtle sweetness and juicy fruit notes are balanced by a lively acidity that keeps the beer crisp and refreshing.
Light-bodied and vibrant, it’s a colourful, fruit-forward sour with a clean, tangy finish.

6621197.beer_description: Crafted with over 90kg of real blueberries, this special edition fruited lager delivers vibrant berry aromatics, a subtle natural sweetness and a gentle tart lift. The clean, crisp lager base keeps it bright and refreshing, allowing the fruit to shine while finishing dry and dangerously easy to drink.

6581340.beer_description: This Japanese Rice Lager is light, crisp, and quietly complex. Flaked rice keeps the body refreshing, while a touch of kombu brings gentle umami and savoury depth.

6584101.beer_description:
We love celebrating with big beers but we also love being able to sit and enjoy a few pints with our mates without worrying about our heads (too much at least) so we’ve replicated our birthday QIPA but in a lower, softer format.

Using the same hop grist as our 11th Birthday QIPA this DDH Pale brings you our characteristic (actually double, and not just twice hopped) fuller hop profile to a more sessionable beer using the Clean Fusion ™ process developed by Nick at One Drop Brewing Co. We believe a sessionable beer should be clean, juicy and soft and this 5% DDH Pale delivers on it. White peach tea from the Idaho 7 blends with fresh green grape, ripe melon rind and a slight floral yet peppery aftertaste from the Motueka. A delightfully clean and refreshing sessionable pale.

6584102.beer_description: Supercharged is a brand new hopping process that takes our beer from dry hop to packaging in less than 24 hours to ensure the freshest of beer profiles for you guys. We’re blessed that we get to sample our beers directly from the tank in their most clean state and we want you guys to get in on this experience too! This Supercharged IPA is one of the softest, juicest, and freshest beers we’ve made, capturing the cleanest form of the hops and canned to ensure the ripest experience. We’ve jam packed this brew with citra, Mosaic, Columbus, Strat CGX and Idaho 7 so there’s no shortage of flavour.

6430985.beer_description: Our Breeze sours are smooth and crushable while capturing the mouthwatering vibrancy of freshly picked fruit. To get the most out of the fruit additions, we layer them on a soft, smooth base, complemented by fruity aroma hops and an acidity that's tart and zippy rather than puckeringly sour. This edition combines both sweet and sour cherries, for a bright and deep flavour.

4952902.beer_description: Seven years of pioneering hazy beers and a blend of hand-selected hops combine in a recipe based on our 2018-2020 Signature Pale.

6575395.beer_description:
This is the second in a new series that explores beyond the new normal. Back in 2016, we helped change expectations in hoppy beer by working outside the box, stepping away from the safety of the familiar, and in this series, we're off for another mooch about. 

A journey for the curious and the adventurous, for individuals in search of new combinations and boundary blurring hybrids. Join us, and help us find something. Whether that's the "next big thing" or just something rather lovely.

5247841.beer_description:
We've created a crisp lager lavishly dry hopped.  While keeping all the refreshing drinkability of a lager.

The suns out in Manchester, enjoy.

5226623.beer_style: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
5226623.beer_description: Proper Birthday DIPA! A tropical celebration of our DIPA made with legendary Manchester yeast from JW Lees. A dank aroma and flavours of mango and apricot puree leads to a smooth but punchy finish.

6575391.beer_description: This beer uses a water profile emulating the central coast of California, providing the perfect foundation for a simple malt base that supports an absolutely classic hop grist - Columbus, Simcoe, Cashmere, Amarillo and Centennial are all used throughout the boil. An extra whirlpool addition of Chinook and Simcoe provides sticky orange, stonefruits and a hearty pine resin bitterness. This underpins a charge of Centennial, Citra and even more Simcoe in the dry hop to provide a refreshingly clean, robustly bitter expression of one of our most beloved styles of beer.

6594180.beer_description:
Our first collaboration with Finnish brewery Factory is a celebration of the vibrant, expressive character of New Zealand hops.

A generous dry hop of Nelson, Riwaka, Motueka and Manilita takes centre stage. Nelson and Riwaka bring their hallmark notes of white grape and overripe mango, while Motueka and Manilita layer in softer impressions of red berries and fresh lime. Aromatics are bold and immediate, leaping from the glass in this celebration of hops.

6575402.beer_style: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
6575402.beer_description:
Our first collaboration with West Coast Brewing, one of Japan’s leading hop forward breweries, was brewed in parallel in Manchester and Shizuoka for a shared release.

Inspired by the idea of hops as umami, this beer is built not around a single hop note, but the full spectrum. Through layered dry hopping, we’ve combined dank and piney depth with citrus, white fruit, tropical and herbal aromatics. Each hop plays a supporting role, enhancing the others to create a bold, mouth filling hop character.

The result is a beer where complexity comes from balancing a hop expression that’s rounded, expressive and deeply satisfying.

6516430.beer_name: CRUMBLE - Cinnamon Dusted Apple Crumble And Vanilla Ice Cream
6516430.beer_description: Cinnamon Dusted Apple Crumble and Vanilla Ice Cream Smoothie Sour with our sour wizard buddies at Elmeleven

6489433.beer_description: The demon returns in its most indulgent form yet, a colossal 12% imperial stout packed with more Salvadorian cacao than ever before, courtesy of our friends at @tablechocolate . Expect layers dark chocolate, rich caramel, velvety sweetness, deep roasted malt, and a smooth, lingering finish.

5589453.beer_description: Helles Lager brewed with all German ingredients.

6498988.beer_description: Our fourth birthday calls for the fourth chapter. SR4 lands with a massive 11%, loaded with maple and pecan for peak dessert-mode indulgence. Thick, sweet, and proudly over the top, exactly how a birthday beer should be. Cheers to four years.

4093203.beer_description: This imperialised expression of our well known and dearly beloved West Coast IPA has been amped up to 9.0%, taking us one step closer to our dream of a utopian beer-scape where the clouds are froth, it rains IPA and the trees are giant hops.

5729091.beer_description:
Celebrate the changing of the seasons with our first Four Seasons release in 2024, brewed for Autumn! This series is a yearly project that brews four different expressions of a common parent style (in this case, IPA) using the same bill of malts and hops, adjusting only proportions and amounts.
This time of year calls for the refreshing brightness of a West Coast along with the warming comfort of 10% ABV. Perfect for enjoying a crisp autumn day!

6201508.beer_description:
2025’s Four Seasons is a dedication to our much-beloved core West Coast IPA. Every season features one of the four hops that go into our Westy (Southern Cross, Simcoe, Mosaic, and Krush), each one paired with a beer style that will suit both the season and the hop.
Autumn calls for an IPA with a little bit of robustitude—prominent malt with a sassy ABV, featuring Simcoe as the star hop. Pine, citrus, and an assertive bitterness compliment a lush, caramelly malt profile. 
Autumn tastes amazing.

6603470.beer_description:
our Seasons is an ongoing project that evolves year on year, defined by a four-part series of seasonal releases that each express the time of year. 2026 is a year of ‘firsts’, every release to feature something that’s never been attempted at Hawkers.
For the first release of the year, Autumn’s expression is the first wet-hopped beer to come out of the Hawkers brewery, loaded with freshly harvested Melba hop cones from Ellerslie Hop Estate.

6455378.beer_description:
2025’s Four Seasons is a dedication to our much-beloved core West Coast IPA. Every season features one of the four hops that go into our Westy (Southern Cross, Simcoe, Mosaic, and Krush), each one paired with a beer style that will suit both the season and the hop.

We’re bringing the heat for summer with our final Four Seasons installation for the year, featuring the last (and far from least) hop from the lineup. Loaded with multiple formats of Mosaic (T90, Cryo®, Hyperboost™), this double IPA ruthlessly beats back the summer sun with the stick of bright, juicy refreshment.

6455341.beer_description:
Hawkers and Good Folk have teamed up for a tasty, juicy, fruit-laden collaboration whose love-child is the tropical hop dream inside this can. A star-studded cast of Mosaic Cryo, Krush, Idaho 7, and Citra Cryo on top of a pillowy-soft canvas of an oat cream body makes this a delightful drink. Throw in a gentle addition of guava, and you’ve got yourself perfection.
Enjoy the ride on the guava train.

4429850.beer_description: Tropical, juicy, and delightfully hazy! Punchy hop vibes take the front seat, defining the dominant character of the beer while a rounded body and low bitterness provide the perfect backdrop for the hops to shine their brightest. The future is hazy!

3999492.beer_description: Generously dry-hopped, deliciously hazy, and stunningly approachable. Massive juice characters about from American and New Zealand hops, delivering the best of both worlds between New England style and sessionability.

2564793.beer_description: Hops, more hops, and then more hops again. That’s our approach to this massive IIPA, which is brimming with juicy and fruity hop notes balanced by prominent bitterness and a full and lush body. Proceed cautiously, it’s dangerously drinkable.

3406174.beer_description: Our IPA is brewed for hop lovers who enjoy bold, complex tropical and citrus characters and a solid malt body. It’s exactly what an IPA should be… rich, robust yet very drinkable.

966225.beer_description: A quintessential American style pale ale, hop forward and very balanced. This beer is a real thirst quencher.

6576876.beer_description: At Hawkers, we take a firm stance that there’s nothing wrong with having a Cryo into your beer. In fact, with this tasty little double west coast, we did it with a trio of Cryo hops for maximum aromatics to complement the finishing bitterness. Simcoe Cryo, Citra Cryo, and Cascade Cryo for a citrusy, floral, and subtle resinous olfactory experience. So good, it might make you cryo.

3387459.beer_description: The isn’t the average industrial lager. Old world and new world hops deliver floral and spicy aromas, setting the stage for a clean, modern pilsner that nods to its old world roots while bringing a certain mischievous youth to the party. Classic, but far from ordinary.

6331702.beer_description: The poor colour red gets a bad rap sometimes, but when it comes to a rich, red frothy brew, it’s an absolute delight. Caramel and toffee malt characters take the helm, balanced by an agreeable bitterness and floral aromatics to turn a basic red into a symphony of flavour. Seeing red? Now you can taste it, too.

2072960.beer_description: Rich aromas of espresso mingle with characters of chocolate and roasted malt atop a pillowy tan head. It’s a seductive dance in the darkness, boasting deep, alluring flavours and a lush, rounded body. Peaceful, dark, and sultry...

2332158.beer_description: The West Coast style has never been accused of subtlety—it’s audacious, unruly, and it definitely doesn’t wait around for pleasantries. Unapologetic quantities of American and Kiwi hops deliver punchy floral aromas with notes of citrus, pine, and resin.

6678165.beer_description: A collision of the boundless black depths of imperial stout and the thick, moreish viscosity of a barleywine! Aged in ex-whisky barrels, flavours of coffee, caramel, and toffee come together to knock your boots clean off. Just remember to come back to earth when you’re done.

6682416.beer_description: Take a journey to the stars with our 2026 Whisky Barrel-Aged Imperial Stout! Every sip is a view into its speckled black depths giving rich, harmonious flavours of whisky with toasty malt aromas and espresso intensity.

6633679.beer_description: It’s not just darkness that veils the unknown mysteries of the universe—sometimes they’re obscured in the light. Bright and clear. yet unexpectedly rich, our 2026 White Stout offers surprising depth with a dessert-like malt profile, punctuated with additions of cacao nibs, coffee, and vanilla. Don’t fear the unexplained, pour it in a glass and enjoy it.

6159937.beer_description:
Celebrate ten years of Hawkers with this epic blended Imperial Stout comprising both youth and maturity. A blend of un-aged and 2+ year bourbon barrel matured imperial stouts unite with a fusing rest on amburana wood, nodding to past, present, and years to come. Find complex vanilla, spice, dried fruit, and coffee characters in its inky depths.
After a decade of hard work and dedication, this beer is the perfect embodiment of time, experience, and growth.
Here’s to ten years.

6665276.beer_description:
Fresh Drop - The Freshest Hops meet the Freshest Beats! This Fresh Hop NZ Pilsner is a high-energy collaboration with our mates at Sure Brewing, bringing an alty, electronic-punk vibe to your glass. This brew is all about raw power, refined rhythm, and a fresh stance. We're ripping up the rulebook and hitting your palate with a deluge of New Zealand fresh hops, ready to electrify your senses.

Flavours: A lean, crisp Pilsner malt base with a touch of dextrine malt sets the stage for a hoppy explosion. Nelson Sauvin, the tried and true passionfruit heavy, sends your senses sky-high. Superdelic, the new trickster of the fruity bunch, excites with notes of sweet berries and tropical mango. Together, these two big hops skate in and drop a beat of vibrant fruit and fresh-hop intensity.

6640657.beer_description:
From the mechanical edge of the Pacific Hop Series - Battle of the Aotearoa Fresh Hops 2026, Jaegar strikes again - precision-engineered for the fresh hop front. This Origins West Coast reloads with seasonal firepower available once per year, so Power Up with this rare hop fuel. Grab both to settle the Kaiju vs Jaegar battle, and wait for the Monarch to arrive.

Flavours: A clean grist of pilsner and wheat malt, with dextrin for backbone, lets the fresh hops shine. Motueka and NZ Cascade from Clayton Hops deliver fresh-squeezed citrus punch - Motueka's mojito lime and lemon zest meet Cascade's bright grapefruit and tropical fruits, finishing with fresh-hop dank edge and crisp snap. (think the face you make biting a lemon, but without the sour)

6663127.beer_description:
Crowning the Pacific Hop Series - Battle of the Aotearoa Fresh Hops 2026, Monarch descends as the ultimate Origins mediator - a colossal fresh hop overlord that subdues both Kai Juice's wild fury and Jaegar's tech precision to enforce supreme order. Wielding Superdelic and Nectaron Fresh Hops from NZ Hops as weapons designed to overpower even the biggest rigs, this triple hazy crushes the chaos and completes the set.

Flavours: Jumbo pilsner malt with triple wheat malt, flaked wheat, and oats, plus maltodextrine for support, builds a warship of softness against the 10.2%. Superdelic and Nectaron form a juicy tropical dankness duo - Superdelic sends red fruit, mango, and sweet berry aromas, while Nectaron detonates pineapple and passionfruit, leveling the playing field.

5011219.beer_description:
#1 Independent Lager in the 2024 GABS Hottest 100 Craft Beer Poll, Alpine Lager has subtle floral and tropical flavours sourced from our local hop growers.

Brewed in the modern Australian style, Alpine Lager is crisp, refreshing, and effortlessly drinkable. Subtle tropical notes lift this classic lager, making it the perfect choice for both long-time lager lovers and those discovering the style anew.

Crafted with pristine mountain water, Alpine Lager has become nationally recognised as the benchmark for new-age Australian lagers—and a true taste of Victoria’s High Country.

4718497.beer_description:
Bright Pale Ale is a true taste of home. Brewed with locally grown hops, it’s a light-bodied, fruit-forward pale ale that’s as easy-drinking as it is flavourful. Expect bright notes of pineapple, passionfruit, and juicy citrus.

As crisp and refreshing as a plunge into alpine waters, Bright Pale Ale is the perfect expression of the modern Australian pale ale.

5890217.beer_description:
Celebrate 18 years of Bright Brewery with a Decadence Barleywine, a luxurious sipper as rich as our history. 

This luxurious barleywine boasts an enticing aroma of crisp apple and warm cinnamon, hinting at the rich flavours to come. 

The first sip unfolds a velvety smooth, full-bodied mouthfeel, accentuated by a high finishing gravity. Decadent notes of caramel and fortified wine dance on the palate, mingling with hints of candied lollipops. As the beer warms, a symphony of dried fruits emerges, with plump raisins and prunes adding a delightful complexity. 

Decadence Barleywine is a testament to our commitment to crafting exceptional mountain beers. Savour it and raise a glass to 18 years of Bright Brewery adventures. 

The Decadence 18th Anniversary Barleywine was brewed for the Carwyn Cellars Black Box 2024.

Malts: Pale, Munich
Hops: Sultana
Yeast: HG-18/HG-1
Colour: Golden orange

6622165.beer_description:
First brewed 20 years ago, Hellfire Amber Ale is our longest running core range beer and a true constant in our range.

Hellfire is a throwback to classic amber ales built on balance, quality and consistency. It has stood firm through decades of change.

To celebrate our 20th anniversary we have trend things up with first ever Imperial Hellfire. Everything you love about the original dialled right up!

Expect a malt driven amber with rich notes of caramel and toffee finished with a subtle nuttiness.

Malts: Pale, Chocolate Wheat, Melanoidin, Dextrin, Dark Munich, Special B, Pilsner
Hops: Columbus
Yeast: AEB AY-4

6587296.beer_name: Infinite Barrel Works American Bourbon Barrel Aged Imperial Stout
6587296.beer_description:
Mountaincrafted with Intention, this is the modus operandi of our Infinite Barrel Works program. It’s not about brewing beer for an occasion, its about allowing beer to reach the highest of heights in quality, whatever time that takes.  Aged in new American bourbon barrels sourced from J. Henry Distillery in Wisconsin, this imperial stout is deeply true to its barrel home. Our master brewers reserved a portion of the 2025 Stubborn Imperial Stout and introduced it to these barrels, creating a beer that speaks of patience and precision.

Expect notes of caramelised oak, vanilla and slight char meld with the rich dark chocolate of the roasted malt to create something truly special. In continuation of our Infinite ethos, this is an incredibly limited beer. Another on our infinite and foolhardy pursuit of brewing perfection.

Malts: Pale, Chocolate, Oat Malt, Munich, Medium Crystal, Dark Crystal, Roast Barley, Dextrose
Hops: Ella
Yeast: AY-4

6381293.beer_description:
Inspired by our love for the refined brews of the Land of the Rising Sun, Kuraidesu is our tribute to Japan in a glass — a premium Japanese dark lager that captures the spirit of Shibuya’s neon-lit alleys, the powdery peaks of Niseko, and the tireless salarymen unwinding in smoky izakayas. Dark as midnight, crisp and dry as tradition demands — this is lager, the Kuraidesu way.

Brewer’s Tasting Notes: “Clean, dark, and crisp with minimal malt bitterness. Exceptionally drinkable. Hopped with Akoya — a Sapporo-developed variety delivering bright citrus and earthy spice.”

Malts:  Pale, Black Rice, Flaked Rice
Hops: Akoya
Yeast: Fermolager W

5776316.beer_description:
It’s Leaf Peeper but not as you know it! After a short hiatus, Leaf Peeper makes its return – with a rye twist!

When the autumn leaves start to change, all roads lead to Bright! Leaf Peeper Red Rye IPA is bursting with red malt, caramel sweetness, and shades of amber, like the the autumn foliage that makes Bright a leef peepin’ mecca!

Malts: : Pale, Caramel Red, Caramel Rye, Special W
Hops: Cascade, Simcoe, Mosaic
Yeast: AEB AY-4
Colour: Red/copper

90586.beer_description:
Named in honour of our former head brewer Jon—who, on the very afternoon the first batch of this IPA was due to be kegged, went for a “quick” lunchtime paraglide (in true Bright fashion) and ended up missing for eight hours after an emergency landing on nearby Mt Feathertop with no phone.

MIA IPA stands as one of the first true West Coast IPAs brewed in Australia. It’s a bold celebration of the style, packed with resinous pine, zesty grapefruit, bright citrus, and a hit of passionfruit—all the big hop flavour you’d expect from a classic West Coast.

5993730.beer_description:
First brewed to quench the thirst of a nation, Mountain Juice is Bright in a can. Brewed using a new hop varietal Dolcita, tailor made for hazy beers. Mountain Juice is packed full of real  pineapple and peach juice flavour. Each sip of the juice brewed specifically to transport you to our little slice of paradise.

Brewer’s Tasting Notes: “Mountain Juice Juicy Pale Ale showcases the new Dolcita hop varietal, delivering layered aromas of peach, pineapple, orange, and tropical cocktail notes. Brewed on a hazy base it offers a soft, pillowy mouthfeel and moderate carbonation. Expect a juicy, fruit-forward palate with low bitterness and a clean finish, perfectly balanced for a refreshing, crushable hazy experience."
Malts: Pale, Oat Malt, Wheat Malt
Hops: MegaTerps, Dolcita, Cryo Citra
Yeast: Pomona

6676690.beer_name: Stone Gold Fresh Hop Golden Ale
6676690.beer_description:
Time to open a can of whoop…Freshness.

This trash talking SOB takes Golden Ale up a notch with fresh hops thrown in less than two hours after picking, locking in all that just off the bine character.

Expect big tropical notes backed by a punchy, ultra fresh hop aroma that hits hard and finishes clean.

Brewer Tasting Notes: “A soft, malt‑driven Pacific‑style golden ale with a gentle sweetness and fresh hop lift. Bright pineapple and passionfruit jump from the glass, courtesy of freshly harvested Vic Secret and Galaxy hops. The palate is smooth and rounded, with light honeyed malt supporting juicy tropical notes and a restrained bitterness. Fresh, vibrant and dangerously easy‑drinking, this is hops at their most expressive and approachable.”

Malts: Pale, Rolled Wheat, Wheat Malt, Carared
Hops: Fresh Hop Vic Secret, Cascade, Galaxy
Yeast:  AY-4

6271878.beer_description:
For nearly two decades, Bright Brewery has embraced the darkness by unleashing the beast—Stubborn Imperial Stout. Like the mythical Alpine bear that adorns its label, this bold brew is not to be taken lightly. Layered with rich espresso and dark chocolate, Stubborn is built for the long haul. Sip it now for a hit of winter warmth, or let it hibernate for something truly special down the track.
Malts: Pale, Chocolate, Oat Malt, Munich, Medium Crystal, Dark Crystal, Roast Barley, Dextrose
Hops: Ella
Yeast: AY-4

6710992.beer_description:
For nearly two decades, Bright Brewery has embraced the darkness by unleashing the beast – Stubborn Imperial Stout. Over the years, our brewers have learnt to expect the unexpected with this brew. But this unpredictable set of circumstances is what sets every vintage of Stubborn Imperial Stout apart from the rest, and imparts its own distinct flavour and character. No two years are the same. Each year, we hold our breath, wondering what the brew will bring.

Like the mythical Alpine bear that adorns its label, this bold brew for 2026 is not to be taken lightly. Layered with rich expresso and dark chocolate, Stubborn is built for the long haul.

Sip it now for a hint of winter warmth, or let it hibernate for something truly special down the track.

Malts: Pale, Chocolate, Oat Malt, Munich, Medium Crystal, Dark Crystal, Roast Barley, Dextrose, Maltodextrin
Hops: Ella
Yeast: AY-4

6603998.beer_description:
Pilsner has long been a brewers quite proving ground, a style defined by clarity, discipline and absolute honesty in the glass. At Bright, we have come to regard pilsners as the brewers moral high ground, a place for tradition and unflinching commitment to quality. There is nowhere to hide in a pilsner, which is exactly why we love it.

Brewed in the Italian style, Terrano Piu Alto presents a brilliantly clean and crisp lager lifted by expressive hop character, gentle spice and a soft floral note. It is a beer that rewards patience, celebrates precision and stands tall among the purest expressions of our craft.

Malts: Weyermann Pilsner Malt
Hops: Mittelfruh, Tettnanger 
Yeast: Fermolager W

28311.beer_description: Our American IPA (formerly Road Trip) is our take on a classic Pacific North-West American IPA. Presenting a burnished copper, Road Trip is loaded with multiple additions of Chinook, Centennial, Simcoe, Citra, Amarillo and Mosaic hops resulting in an explosion of piney, citrus and grapefruit flavour and aroma. The palate is rich and full, with the same archetypal American hop flavours dancing over a foundation of rich malt and a firm hop bitterness. The dry finish makes this a dangerously drinkable drop.

1211972.beer_description: Originally named Alpha Crucis after the brightest star in the Southern Cross, this big hoppy extra pale ale celebrates Australian malt and hops. Full of sweet tropical fruit and zingy citrus hop flavour with a moderate bitterness, it’s a session beer for hop lovers!star in the Southern Cross Constellation.

55753.beer_description:
One of the two beers that launched the Holgate Brewhouse in 1999, this classic English ESB gives a nod to Paul Holgate’s Lancashire heritage and has been a staple beer at the Holgate Pub and cellar door.
Brewed with English crystal and roast malts this ESB shows a classic copper-red colouring, and a traditional biscuity malt flavour with hints of caramel and toffee. An abundance of East Kent Goldings hops late in the boil gives this ale the classic English profile of earthy and spicy hop aroma and flavour to balance the delicious malt backbone.

470596.beer_description: This is a traditional unfiltered Bavarian Weiss Bier, lightly hopped and brewed with 60% wheat. Yeast-driven spicy clove and sweet banana esters make for a refreshing and easy drinking classic.

6628040.beer_description:
A lorry full of English Pale Ale kegs has been stolen - and everyone in Hopton-on-the Green is a suspect! But who took this golden brew, full of fruity, citrusy hops*, balanced by traditional Golden Promise malt and fermented with classic British yeast? Can PC Porter follow the clues to the bitter end?

A modern-style English Pale, the hops in our Hop Fuzz are a blend of Old and New World, with soft stone fruit vibes alongside the more traditional English hop character such as citrusy orange and earthy herbal flavours. All this is underpinned by a firm bitterness befitting an English Pale.

313871.beer_description:
Get ready for a tropical hop hit from beyond the stars! May the hops be with you!

First brewed in 2013 to mark our 1000th brew, the Millennium Falcon is made with pale malt and an interstellar hopping rate to produce an "Emperial" IPA that is simply out of this world.

6665130.beer_description:
This intergalactic ‘13th edition’ of our iconic Millennium Falcon Emperial IPA features a star-studded cast of hop favourites.

Get yours before May 4th and be ready to turn the tropical hop blasters to hyperdrive!

First brewed in 2013 to mark our 1000th brew, Millennium Falcon is made with pale malt and an interstellar hopping rate to produce an “Emperial” IPA that is simply out of this world. For this year’s release, the hopping schedule has again been tweaked and features a star-studded cast of favourites both old and new.

This year, the brewers decided to shave a little off the ABV to make this massive beer more drinkable, though they stopped short of calling it a sessionable Imperial IPA! The aroma is chock-full of super-fruity US hop aroma – think juicy pineapple, tart citrus, stone fruit, boiled lollies and bubblegum. On the palate, the fruity mélange is underpinned by a bold, evergreen hop bitterness. Mouthfeel is full and luxurious yet at the same time dangerously drinkable.

5580202.beer_description: In the 19th century the Bohemian brewers of Plzn invented the world’s most drinkable beer. In true craft style, the 21st century brewers at Holgate have re-created this classic lager, a light bodied and delicately balanced beer with serious flavour. Brewed with 100% imported Bavarian pilsner malt and Czech Saaz hops, the Holgate Pilsner is fermented at a cool 10 degrees and takes much longer to come to fruition, but we think it’s worth the wait.

2897439.beer_description: Pouring a deep and delicious rose, Wild Berry Sour (ex Blush) has a sweet and inviting forest fruit aroma with a hint of zesty citrus. Across the palate the sweet berry fruits blend beautifully with a light tartness and a lemony hop character. The finish is clean and dry with a refreshing sour edge - a true new world beer, not bound by style but led by the brewers' fancy for a quenching summer ale.

1522653.beer_description:
This small-batch Flanders style Wild Red Ale is barrel-aged and soured.

Ultra limited release. Perfect for the beer curious and connoisseur alike.

The 2021 iteration of Wild Red Ale is the culmination of a slow, 18-month period of souring and maturation in ex-Pinot Noir barrels. A complex malt bill with generous amounts of European specialty malts have produced a beer that pours a rich ruby hue and balances a zesty acidity with residual malt sweetness. The aroma and palate are rich and complex with lashings of dark fruit character: think black plums and tart berries. The fruit character is backed up by creamy oak-derived vanillin. These rounded flavours are balanced by a sharp and tangy acidity with notes of balsamic and sour cherries.

6721164.beer_description:
Chart a course for flavour with our X Marks the Spot, an adventurous XPA bursting with tropical treasure. Juicy pineapple leads the charge, backed by bright citrus and a subtle hint of hoppy spice, adding intrigue to every sip. The voyage finishes crisp and dry, leaving a clean, refreshing wake. Ahoy, me hearties. This here be liquid gold.

Showcasing a blend of US and Australian hops, we used cooler whirlpool temperatures to help lock in the delicate aromatics, delivering lifted citrus and subtle tropical notes. Light-bodied with a crisp finish, firm bitterness and a clean malt base, it’s refreshing, balanced and highly sessionable for everyday drinking appeal.

5612070.beer_description: Thronging with balanced New World American hops in a hellishly good taste of the dark side, there's none more black than this Black IPA. An absolute headbanger's ball of citrus and resin characters dancing over roasty bones of malt and coffee. Reckless invites you to crank up the amps and shred the night away with this quality doom fuel.

6715805.beer_name: Black IPA - Sea Legs Brewing X Reckless Brewing Co Collaboration
6715805.beer_description:
Sea Legs Brewing x Reckless Brewing Co Collaboration.
Transmission received: Black IPA. Citra and Centennial hops detected, with traces of Nelson from beyond. Caramel malt body engaged. Roasty finish confirmed. Drink fresh before it disappears back into the void

6381251.beer_description: RETURN OF THE BLOODY MARY GOSE! We’ve taken the bold, savoury spirit of the Bloody Mary and given it the Reckless twist. Brewed as a tart, refreshing Gose with fresh tomato juice, a dash of Tabasco, and a handful of secret spices, this brew is spicy, salty, and seriously satisfying. Think brunch in a tin — a full-bodied, slightly sour brew that’s equal parts cocktail curiosity and sessionable sipper.

6654387.beer_description:
This Chocolate Stout is packed with roasted malt, proper chocolate vibes and just enough bitterness to keep it honest. Full-bodied without being heavy, it’s the kind of beer you sip slowly. Pouring dark as a moonless night, and drinking just as easy with rich flavours and an easy finish, it’s the sort of beer you reach for when you’re not in a rush. 
The footy’s on, the fire’s going and the night’s got legs.

6088580.beer_description: Supple and silky with a mouthfeel like soft clouds, this hazy pale ale is custom-built to bring on the good times. Packed with oats, wheat and malt, the palate is round and smooth, plush with juicy New World American and Australian hops for that signature tropical and citrus taste sensation. Flavoursome and refreshing in equal measure, in true Reckless style.

6765203.beer_description:
Brewed with coffee roasted from Bathurst legends Black Crow Coffee, this Iced Vanilla Latte Stout is smooth, roasty and dangerously easy to drink. 
Layers of cold brewed coffee, dark chocolate and roasted malt roll straight into creamy vanilla sweetness, backed by a silky body and just enough bitterness to keep the whole thing from turning into dessert. Think iced vanilla latte energy just louder, darker and significantly less appropriate before midday.
A breakfast-adjacent stout - contains Lactose.

6745011.beer_description: Out on the new frontier. Showcasing both classic and modern New World hops, this IPA is packed with punchy pineapple and tropical fruit aromas, with a hit of bright citrus in the mix. A solid bitterness tracks to keep things balanced, backed by a clean malt base for an easy, refreshing finish.

6733952.beer_description: Saddled up with classic New World Hops, this Pale Ale leans into resinous pine and subtle citrus, backed by a fuller malt body that adds a bit more grit and balance. Smooth bitterness, clean finish and easy drinking from first pour to sundown.

3704835.beer_description:
Better red than dead we reckon, which is why we’ve packed this Red IPA fit to burst with Mosaic and Citra hops woven around a full, malty base. An AIBA Gold Medal-winning beer, it’s a flavourful yet well-balanced and aromatic brew that’s just the thing for a mellow night around the fire with your besties chatting about, you know, stuff.
Unfiltered, Unpasteurised, No Preservatives.

6598204.beer_description: This bold IPA is built from the best Victoria has to offer. Featuring Eclipse & VIC Secret - born and bred down in the Garden State, it’s all juicy tropical & pine wrapped up in a crisp, classic finish. From the Yarra to the Murray - you’ll find this beer is best enjoyed anywhere from the high country to the coast.

6616693.beer_description: This West Coast Pilsner dials up the intensity and delivers more than meets the eye. Clean lager vibes with New World American hops brings out a punchy citrus lift. Low malt presence keeps it super clean, dry and stupidly easy to knock back Best enjoyed cold... preferably with another lined up ready to go.

743014.beer_description:
A dark ale with roasty coffee, nutty and hoppy flavours and aromas.

Hops: Columbus

5799475.beer_description: Cluster 10 takes everything you love about XPAs and dials it up a notch—or ten! This brew is a complex symphony of flavours that remains supremely drinkable. A milestone in a glass, perfect for acknowledging the ride we've had and the roads still to explore. Whether you're a long-time fan or just joining us at the bar, here's to ten incredible years and to many more to come.

828339.beer_description:
Rumoured to be the 8th Wonder of the World, our iconic Imperial IPA doesn’t disappoint. Showcasing the best American hop flavours and aromas of tropical mango, pineapple, ripe peaches and grapefruit, perfectly balanced by clean malt body and smooth finish.

Hops: Galaxy, Citra, Mosaic, Centennial, Simcoe, Amarillo

4869805.beer_description: Descent 22, our birthday beer, has descended. This Imperial Stout is aged in foeder barrels for 6 months, allowing the immersion of vanilla, oak and wild yeast characters that combine with the roasty, bitter, black malt leather-like esters to complete this winter warmer.

704580.beer_description:
A legendary return from the brew that started it all. This American-style brown ale is a nod to our very first mash, and it's been a beloved tradition to brew it every Good Friday since. A time capsule that captures the spirit of innovation and nostalgia in every sip. Dick Tracy will charm your palate packed with rich, robust malts and artfully layered with fruity hops. This brew will remind you why some classics are worth revisiting.

Hops: Citra, Fuggles & US Cascade

869118.beer_description: Inspired by the zing of a freshly picked raspberry, this juicy raspberry beer is a tad tart, a touch sweet and a whole lot of refreshing. Made with real, juicy raspberries, Frenzy is the perfect beer to enjoy on a scorching Summer to come.

1087672.beer_description: This Nitro Stout is anything but what the name suggests with a velvety smooth palette and roasty, slightly astringent stout characteristics The style originated by the need to supply stout to tropical areas of the world from the UK. These were brewed with higher alcohol and higher quantity of hops to help preserve the beer on its travels. Pale Barley Malt, Roast Barley, Wheat and Oats combine to brew a strong roasty, slightly coffee-like stout.

5497667.beer_description: This hazy pale ale is light and fruity, sessionable and approachable.

6689625.beer_description: Night Shifter 4.0% Dark Lager clocks on delivering gentle roasted malt notes layered with a crisp, clean edge and an unexpectedly light body. It pours deep and shadowy, yet drinks with effortless ease. A dry, refreshing finish keeps it sharp and sessionable, ready for whatever the day or night throws your way. Dark in the glass but easy on the palate, Night Shifter is the smooth operator for when you’re ready to switch gears to something a little darker.

1374050.beer_description: A red IPA with a resiny hop and rich caramel malt character. Hops: Fortnight, Mosaic, Citra, East Kent Goldings and Amarillo

6543158.beer_description:
Bursting with intense passionfruit, ripe feijoa, pineapple and fresh dankness. Sublimely sessionable with a light body and smooth finish.

From trails to tastebuds, Switchback is the XPA made for post-adventure refreshment. Whether you’ve been chasing singletrack, summiting a ridge, or just kicking back with mates - this is the beer for the ride home.

6762343.beer_description: A berry-forward sour ale balancing tart refreshment with juicy fruit character. Dark malt adds depth while Lactobacillus fermentation delivers a bright, tangy sourness, creating a flavour profile reminiscent of sweet-and-sour berries and fruity lollies.

6762292.beer_description: This hard-hitting 6.5% West Coast IPA showcases innovative hops straight out of Yakima, delivering bold aromas of fruity pine, dank resin and subtle geranium. Crisp, refreshing and packed with punchy bitterness, it's everything you want from a classic West Coast IPA.

5936149.beer_description:
Hailing from Wallonia, this beer style was traditionally brewed in the colder months, aged through spring, and ready to quench the thirst of farm workers in the fields. Saisons have roots back to the dawn of agriculture when workers needed a safe-to-drink beverage and lots of it!
BentSpoke’s take on this classic undergoes extended aging in a foeder and barrel. It's the perfect refreshment after a day on the slopes!
